issue.author: al42and
issue.body:
When cross-compiling the following code for `-march=rv64gcv -mrvv-vector-bits=16384`, I get an ICE

```c
void* memcpy();
struct s
{
    char g[2048];
};
void a(struct s *dst, const int *src)
{
    memcpy(dst, src, sizeof(*dst));
}
```
